title: SciCook Diwali Night — Light Shared Is Light Multiplied

long_description:
Celebrate Diwali with festive thali, masala chai, community rangoli, diya lighting, music and dance at SciEats. Open to all!

About this Event

Reserve your tickets using the Get tickets button on this Eventbrite page. General admission is $15 per person, plus Eventbrite fees.

Join SciCook at SciEats for Diwali Night on November 7, 6–8 PM. Enjoy festive thali (vegetarian/vegan or non-vegetarian), mithai, masala chai, community rangoli, diya lighting, Indian classical music and dance. Open to all!

Capacity: 50 guests. RSVP by November 1. Every ticket supports the All In community meal program.

Free or discounted admission is available by request, no questions asked. Find details, request assistance, or view other payment options on SciCook: 

 https://cdn-az.allevents.in/events9/banners/0a6e60a0-d464-11f1-bfe4-87b36aec9925-rimg-w592-h740-dc080818-gmir.jpg
